prompt: Draft an email to a small bookshop asking whether it could host a reading by three local writers. Mention that the group can provide its own chairs if needed and is flexible about dates. A response of around 120 words is enough.
text:
Subject: Inquiry About Hosting a Local Writers’ Reading

Dear [Bookshop Name/Owner],

I’m writing to ask whether your bookshop might be interested in hosting a reading by three local writers. We would be delighted to share our work with your customers and community, and we’re happy to discuss the format, timing, and any practical arrangements that would work best for you.

We are flexible about dates and can adapt to your schedule. If seating is limited, we can also provide our own chairs. Please let us know whether this might be possible, and if so, what information you would need from us.

Thank you for considering our request. We look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
